commands: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 25,587,465,110,143,993,995 } | ForEach-Object { $p=(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName; "LISTEN $($_.LocalPort) pid=$($_.OwningProcess) proc=$p" }
'=== IIS sites binding any mail.* host ==='
$svc = Get-Service -Name SMTPSVC -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($svc) { "SMTPSVC: $($svc.Status)" } else { 'SMTPSVC: not installed' }
